name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing: Sol 6.1 / High declares solo, delegate, audit, or exceptional full delivery before work begins.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol 6.1 / High, declare a risk-gated route, and use at most one auxiliary by default.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-6.1 Sol / High in the primary session for architecture, implementation when solo or audit is selected, verification, and acceptance. Before the first task tool call, Sol declares a machine-auditable SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate uses native generic dispatch with explicit GPT-6 Luna / Max for bounded work, GPT-6.1 Terra (gpt-6.1-terra) at a live-supported effort for scoped code, visual, computer-use, or writing work, or GPT-6 Sol / High for higher-risk work; audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-6 Sol / High review; full combines one selected implementer with a fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Public spawn model and effort metadata is authoritative and conflicting, unavailable, or unobservable auxiliary routing evidence fails closed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
